about: Written by backend/scripts/export_parity_cases.py; never edit by hand. Each case: decide's shown products and their contributions on the shopper's rubric, new slider weights, and decide's own weighted ranking with them (US-23, P-42). Each filter case: what decide's filter read, and what its real filter does with the budget lowered and raised and each rule switched over. src/test/parity.test.ts checks the browser against every one.
